# Personal Buddy

> Made-to-order 3D printed robots and electronic desk companions, designed, printed, assembled, and programmed in Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada. Prices in CAD.

Personal Buddy is a small Halifax workshop building custom 3D printed robots: desk companions with real electronics inside, including a clock, alarm, temperature and humidity sensors, RGB lighting, and an animated face. Every unit is made to order for one customer, tested before shipping, and covered by a 12-month limited warranty. Keywords: 3D robot, 3D printed robot, 3D printed device, robot in Canada, robot in Halifax, custom desk companion, 3D printed electronics.

## Direct answers

- [What is Personal Buddy?](https://personalbuddy.ca/index.html#faq): A made-to-order 3D printed robot and desk companion built in Halifax, Canada. It keeps time, sounds alarms, reads temperature and humidity, glows, and shows an animated face. From $259 CAD.
- [Where can I buy a 3D printed robot in Canada?](https://personalbuddy.ca/index.html#faq): From Personal Buddy in Halifax, Nova Scotia. Priced in Canadian dollars from $259 CAD, with Canada-wide tracked shipping and free local pickup by appointment.
- [How much does a custom 3D printed robot cost?](https://personalbuddy.ca/index.html#pricing): Starter $259 CAD, Smart $289, Premium $335, fully custom from $399, Voice from $1,049 (coming soon).
- [How do I order a custom robot in Halifax?](https://personalbuddy.ca/how-it-works.html): Configure at /build.html for a live price estimate, or describe your idea at /custom.html for a human-reviewed quote. Lead time is 2 to 3 weeks.

## Product tiers

- [Buddy Starter](https://personalbuddy.ca/build.html): $259 CAD - clock, alarm, OLED animated face, buzzer, buttons, USB-C
- [Buddy Smart](https://personalbuddy.ca/build.html): $289 CAD - adds temperature, humidity, Wi-Fi, RGB lighting
- [Buddy Premium](https://personalbuddy.ca/build.html): $335 CAD - adds touch (pre-order), weather (pre-order), custom messages (pre-order)
- [Buddy Custom](https://personalbuddy.ca/custom.html): $399+ CAD - quote-based, human reviewed
- [Buddy Voice](https://personalbuddy.ca/buddies.html#voice): $1,049+ CAD - on-device voice companion, coming soon

## Honesty notes

- No fake reviews. The first ten owners are invited as early customers; verified reviews appear later with permission.
- All AI-generated images and video are labelled "Concept render".
- Every feature is tagged AVAILABLE, PRE-ORDER, or COMING SOON. Coming soon is roadmap, not sold.
- Prices are estimates until confirmed; taxes and shipping are calculated before payment.
